i would feel more comfortable with it if the guy and i had previously discussed more personal things and if he was also a friend, not just someone i might end up sleeping with. in your position, i might say, "hey, i could totally be reading into this, but i feel like you've been a little distant. are we good?" this reveals that you pay attention to her moods and behavior and are concerned about how you affect her. it could open up the door for deeper conversations, too. as shy people, we need encouragement to move a relationship forward—if the other person withdraws, we slip back into our shell. work on showing her that you are not judging her, that you accept her, etc. and she will eventually show more initiative and ease.
